statements.t: The Company continues to progress major construction at its Thacker Pass lithium project in Humboldt County, Nevada (“ Thacker Pass ” or the “ Project ”), with Phase 1 1 targeting mechanical completion in late 2027, with ramp-up through 2028.
We are proud to build a lithium operation expected to help secure America’s critical mineral independence, which is key for national security.”
The Company continues to progress major construction at Thacker Pass Phase 1, targeting mechanical completion in late 2027, with ramp-up through 2028.
